governance_decisions.blocking_reason: Changing the duration impacts the master, build plan, Build-12, Build-13, merge gates, tests, and promotion semantics.

governance_decisions.current_canon: The LIGHT shadow truth phase activated A/B/C/D and Build-14 at 100%, which created ambiguity with the COMPLETE rollout envelope.
governance_decisions.proposed_change: Reserve COMPLETE for the rollout envelope only, and name the Build-11 full-observation phase 'Shadow intégral'.
governance_decisions.rule_until_decided: Use 'Shadow intégral' for the LIGHT shadow truth phase. Do not use 'solution complète' or 'shadow complet' when the intent is the Build-11 LIGHT shadow with all components active in observation.

governance_decisions.current_canon: Some active docs still used narrative wording that could blur profiles, runtime modes, and named phases.
governance_decisions.proposed_change: Read every rollout state as 'profil + runtime_mode', and keep named phases as human-readable aliases only.
governance_decisions.rule_until_decided: Use the canonical matrix: LIGHT+SHADOW, LIGHT+MICRO_LIVE, LIGHT+LIVE, COMPLETE+SHADOW, COMPLETE+LIVE. Do not describe LIGHT as if it 'contains' stages.

governance_decisions.current_canon: The active canon keeps two rollout envelopes: LIGHT then COMPLETE, with Build-11/12/13 on LIGHT and a later COMPLETE Shadow/Live path.
governance_decisions.proposed_change: Migrate to one complete V5.3 rollout chain: full development, Shadow proof 30 days, Shadow confirmation 15 days, Micro-live 15 days, then Live.
governance_decisions.blocking_reason: This would rewrite the rollout doctrine and impacts the master, build plan, Build-11 to Build-14 specs, merge gates, protocol contracts, tests, runtime counters, and monitoring/UI semantics.
governance_decisions.rule_until_decided: Keep the current canon active. Treat the single-chain doctrine as a target proposal only, documented separately, until an explicit governance decision approves the migration.

governance_decisions.topic: Operator-governed degradation and emergency manual kill
governance_decisions.current_canon: The active canon already requires rollback, DEGRADED, HALTED, kill-switch readiness, and a locked UI, but it does not yet define the future single-chain downgrade protocol as a local UI-governed control plane.
governance_decisions.proposed_change: In the target doctrine, all visible degradation transitions must be manually triggered through the local operator UI, with a mandatory emergency manual kill action, confirmation, reason capture, and structured audit logging.
governance_decisions.blocking_reason: This requirement must be reflected later in protocol contracts, runtime state transitions, monitoring projections, and the future local operator UI.
governance_decisions.rule_until_decided: For the target single-chain migration, keep phase downgrades operator-governed via local UI. Hard safety interlocks may still auto-block order emission, but they must not silently perform a rollout phase transition.

governance_decisions.topic: Fixed requalification matrix for the target doctrine
governance_decisions.current_canon: The active canon allows rollback and downgrade logic in spirit, but it does not yet define one fixed transition matrix with explicit requalification durations and a phase field.
governance_decisions.proposed_change: Freeze the target doctrine around one governed transition matrix: SHADOW_PROOF_30D -> SHADOW_CONFIRMATION_15D -> MICRO_LIVE_15D -> LIVE, plus fixed downgrade paths toward MICRO_LIVE_15D, SHADOW_CONFIRMATION_15D, SHADOW_PROOF_30D, or HALTED.
governance_decisions.blocking_reason: The matrix is documented, but it still requires explicit governance approval before replacing the active LIGHT/COMPLETE canon and before code-wide migration.
governance_decisions.rule_until_decided: Use the fixed 15-day and 30-day requalification matrix as the target doctrine reference only. Do not silently inject it into the active canon or broad code surfaces before the build-by-build audit and governance checkpoint.
